adql: SELECT ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 19 AND (phot_g_mean_mag < 16 OR (pm > 5 * SQRT(0.5 * (POWER(pmra_error, 2) + POWER(pmdec_error, 2))) OR parallax_over_error > 5)) AND 1 = CONTAINS(POINT(ra, dec), CIRCLE(34.369, -5.2, 0.6))
